detail: Vietnam’s tourism database describes the paired roof slopes, ridge dragons and sun, stone dragons beside the hall steps, and the three-tier octagonal tower.
Đà Lạt’s municipal tourism site confirms the historic 1938–1940 building and the address at 120 Nguyễn Văn Trỗi.
The Đà Lạt gazetteer lists the hilltop main sanctuary and establishment.
